date.as_written: nepālahāyanagate yugavedakāme māse śvine śitatithau kamalāsane smin

notes: No personal names appear in the colophon; the scribe refers to himself only with the pronoun 'me' (atra me ... vyalikhyat). The chronogram 'yugavedakāme' yields NS 544 (yuga = 4, veda = 4, kāma = 5), whereas the catalogue suggests NS 542.
